title: Lifting reverse-degree stalk components without equations
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open, and $P$ a strictly perfect cochain complex on the slice over $U$ [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Let $T\subseteq V\subseteq U$ be opens, $x\in T$, and $S_V$ the termwise open module stalk functor at $x$ [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor]. Write $P_V=P|_V$. Given component maps $h^{i,j}:S_V(P_V)^i\to S_V(P_V)^j$, zero whenever $j+1\ne i$, there are an open $Z\subseteq T$ containing $x$, a natural comparison $e:R_{Z,V}S_Z\cong S_V$ on cochain complexes, and maps $k^{i,j}:P_V|_Z^i\to P_V|_Z^j$, zero whenever $j+1\ne i$, with $S_Z(k^{i,j})=e_{P_V}^i h^{i,j}(e_{P_V}^{j})^{-1}$. No equation involving the differentials is required.

proof.text: The bounded support of P leaves finitely many reverse-degree pairs. Restrict the finite-free retractions, and apply the internal-Hom stalk comparison to represent the maps in these pairs near x. Equivalently sandwich each map into its finite free terms and lift its finite matrix of germs. Intersect the neighbourhoods with T.

Set all other pairs to zero. The zero terms outside the bounded support prove equality of the discarded components, and the prescribed reverse-degree support proves the zero condition. The canonical open stalk comparison gives e and its naturality gives the displayed component equation.

theorem exists_perfect_open_stalk_reverse_components_lift
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (P : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hP : IsStrictlyPerfect X U P)
    (x : X) (V : X.Opens) (hxV : x ∈ V) (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (T : X.Opens) (hTV : T ≤ V) (hxT : x ∈ T)
    (h : ∀ i j : ℤ,
      ((openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨x, hxV⟩).obj
        ((((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
          (homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P).X i)) ⟶
      ((openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨x, hxV⟩).obj
        ((((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
          (homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P).X j)))
    (hzero : ∀ i j, ¬ (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel j i → h i j = 0) :
    ∃ (Z : X.Opens) (hZT : Z ≤ T) (hxZ : x ∈ Z),
      let PV := ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
      let R := (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE (hZT.trans hTV))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
      let S := (openModuleStalkFunctor X Z ⟨x, hxZ⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
      let F := (openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨x, hxV⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
      ∃ (e : R ⋙ S ≅ F) (k : ∀ i j : ℤ, (R.obj PV).X i ⟶ (R.obj PV).X j),
        (∀ i j, ¬ (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel j i → k i j = 0) ∧
        ∀ i j, (openModuleStalkFunctor X Z ⟨x, hxZ⟩).map (k i j) =
          (e.app PV).hom.f i ≫ h i j ≫ (e.app PV).inv.f j
